about: The lines of UDS Table 6A and the codes that put a visit on each. Codes are written as the manual writes them: a trailing dash means any code that starts with those characters (J45- is J45 and everything under it); 'A through B' is every code from A to B, each end read as a prefix; x means any digit (D21xx through D29xx is D2100 to D2999); '(exclude ...)' removes codes from the entry it follows; '(unless ... at the same visit)' drops the code when the other code is on the same visit. Dots are ignored when matching. Diagnoses (section diagnoses) count only at countable visits. Services count at any encounter in the year at an in-scope site, for patients with at least one countable visit. ages limits a line by age at the visit: fromYears/toYears (inclusive) or fromMonths/toMonths (inclusive). computed says how much of the line the module can count without its value sets: full; partial (the listed codes, but not the value set or the extra condition in limit); or none (the line is defined only by value sets, and is left blank). valueSets are the manual's OIDs. Their codes are never in this file: each site fetches them from the Value Set Authority Center with its own UMLS API key, and withValueSets says how much of the line is counted once all of them are fetched (full, or partial with a limit). A value set code that the line's own entry excludes still doesn't count. personnel limits a line to visits with staff of those Table 5 service categories (medical, dental, ...), as Table 5 places the visit's provider; a visit whose provider has no known line doesn't count on it. prescriptions limits a line to patients with a prescription in the year, or a medication given from inventory, whose name contains all the words of one entry (any case); brand names are listed beside the manual's generic names.
basis: 2026 UDS Manual (HRSA, revised 2026-08-10), Table 6A on pages 79-83 and its instructions on pages 71-75. PDF sha256 02761d82af5b4786. Line labels are the manual's, shortened where marked.

codeSystems.cdt: Any billing code of the form D plus four digits (CDT codes are HCPCS Level II D-codes; OpenEMR has no CDT code type)
codeSystems.snomed: OpenEMR billing code types SNOMED, SNOMED-CT and SNOMED-PR
codeSystems.cvx: Vaccines recorded in the Immunizations screen (CVX codes, written without leading zeros, as OpenEMR stores them). Not in the manual: each line's CVX codes are those that CDC's CPT-to-CVX crosswalk maps from the line's CPT codes (cpt.txt, updated 2026-07-07). CPT 90712 (oral poliovirus) and 90724 (influenza, a retired code) have no CVX there.
